sourceSentences: Olaf throws an axe to the target location that deals physical damage to enemies it passes through and slows them
The axe remains in place for a duration equal to Undertow's cooldown, granting sight of its surroundings for 0.5 seconds. Olaf can pick up the axe to reduce Undertow's current cooldown
The timer for how long an axe stays on the ground does not begin until it has landed, thus it is possible to throw another axe before retrieving the first.
Projectile-intercepting effects (e.g. Wind Wall, Unbreakable) cannot destroy the axe, they will instead cause it to stop prematurely and remain on the ground upon collision.
Tough It Out resets Olaf's basic attack timer.
If Reckless Swing kills the target, Olaf heals himself equal to the health cost.
As with all abilities with health costs, Reckless Swing will not reduce Olaf's health below 1 hp.
Ragnarok's duration is increased by and up to 2.5 seconds for each basic attack on-hit or cast of Reckless Swing against an enemy champion.
Ragnarok removes the underlying stun from airborne effects, but not the forced displacement
Ragnarok will not expire during Reckless Swing cast time.
Ragnarok's duration will not be increased if the basic attack is dodged.
Ragnarok's duration will be increased if the basic attack is blocked.
Olaf's passive ability gives him attack speed and lifesteal that increase based on lost health.
Olaf can pick up his axe from the ground to reduce the cooldown of this ability.
Regarding combos: hit Q, activate your ultimate, approach, attack, reset the auto-attack animation via W, then E and continue attacking.
Every time he attacks an enemy champion or uses E on them, it refreshes the cooldown of the ability.
